guidelines_to_respond.response_length: How long your writing usually runs — a few lines, a couple of paragraphs, longer.
guidelines_to_respond.tone: The tone you want every piece to carry.
guidelines_to_respond.user_reference: How your reader is addressed: by name, as you, as a group.
guidelines_to_respond.prohibited_actions: What should this never do? Think of what would make you wince — a hard sell, a fake deadline, advice outside your lane, sounding certain about something you aren't.
guidelines_to_respond.role_and_focus: The role the writing speaks from, and what it keeps coming back to.
identity.name: Your name, or your business name — whichever the writing speaks as.
identity.role: What you are to the people you serve, in one line.
identity.core_traits: The traits that define you, one per line.
identity.tone_of_voice: Words that describe how you sound, one per line.
mission_and_vision.mission_statement: What you are trying to change for them, and who they are.
mission_and_vision.vision_statement: Your mission is what you do now. Your vision is what the world looks like if you succeed. Most people only have the first. Take a minute on the second.
goals_and_objectives.primary_goals: What you want a reader to walk away with, one per line.
goals_and_objectives.secondary_goals: What you want them to get eventually, one per line.
behavior_and_interaction_style.default_b: How you show up when you write, one per line.
behavior_and_interaction_style.response_: How replies are shaped, one per line.
behavior_and_interaction_style.learning_: How you adjust to the person in front of you.
knowledge_and_expertise.core_expertise: What you are an authority on, one per line.
knowledge_and_expertise.secondary_expert: What you know well enough to speak to, one per line.
cultural_and_philosophical_alignment.ins: The ideas that shaped how you work — and who they came from, so you can credit them.
cultural_and_philosophical_alignment.phi: The belief underneath the way you work.
communication_guidelines.language: Language rules: words to use, words to avoid, one per line.
communication_guidelines.formatting: Formatting rules: length of lines, lists, emoji, one per line.
communication_guidelines.inclusivity: How you keep the writing open to everyone it is for.
emotional_intelligence.empathy: How you show someone you understand what they are going through.
emotional_intelligence.encouragement: How you encourage someone without empty cheer.
emotional_intelligence.conflict_resoluti: When someone is upset, frustrated or pushing back — what do you do first? Most people have never written this down, and it is what separates a warm brand from a brittle one.
systems_and_methodology.frameworks: The named frameworks and methods you teach or use, one per line.
systems_and_methodology.tools: The tools you use or recommend, one per line.
brand_and_differentiation.unique_value_p: Why you and not someone else doing the same thing? Not your features. The reason someone picks you.
brand_and_differentiation.signature_styl: The thing people recognise as yours.
key_outcomes_for_users.clarity: What becomes clear for someone after they work with you or read you.
key_outcomes_for_users.impact: What is different in their life afterwards.
key_outcomes_for_users.connection: What the relationship feels like by the time you are done.
ethical_standards.transparency: What you are open about, always.
ethical_standards.inclusivity: Who you make sure is never left out.
ethical_standards.empowerment: How you leave people more capable, not more dependent.
representative_stories.stories: Your own story — what you came through, and what it taught you. Client results go in the proof bank, not here.
